final_summary.conclusion:
The gentle penalty reduces invalidity substantially relative to the reference, but neither setting meets the combined simulator targets.
Moderate weight 0.01 reduces mean invalidity by only 1.83 percentage points versus gentle weight 0.001, and worsens invalidity at one of three seeds.
Return KL and ACF error worsen in every matched seed. Its small average validity gain is not an overall improvement.
Separate price/volume noise checks retain variation, but do not prove realistic dynamics; strong-penalty pilots showed near-collapse.
Full and partial reconstruction weighting also failed, and all attempts remain visible.

Use the faithful reference and gentle penalty as the main scientific comparison, with the moderate and weighted losses as documented trade-offs and failures.
The log-return TimeGAN has not reliably learned valid order books under this protocol. A temporal-supervision ablation remains untested.
Before any final test scoring, freeze the experiment configuration and evaluation; test scoring was not performed during this session.

supervision_ablation.name: No temporal supervision
supervision_ablation.hypothesis: Measure whether temporal supervision improves order-book fidelity relative to the unpenalised released-code reference.
supervision_ablation.scope: No S-only warm-up, no temporal terms in G/S or E/R; five networks, moments, adversarial losses and data unchanged.
supervision_ablation.pairing: Consume omitted warm-up sampler draws so joint minibatches/noise match the reference; no extra joint updates.
supervision_ablation.interpretation: Removing supervision changed invalidity from 72.06% to 80.83%; invalidity improved in 1/3 matched seeds. Return KL changed from 0.775 to 0.816, and ACF error from 0.125 to 0.367. These are validation-selected checkpoints under equal reconstruction/joint budgets, with the supervised stage omitted in the ablation. Removing supervision worsened mean invalidity and temporal error, so the supervised reference is retained. Three training seeds and one stock/day limit generalisation; this does not establish a book-validity guarantee.

temporal_audit.interpretation: AR has nearly zero absolute-return ACF. A small scalar ACF error on this short-window dataset alone does not demonstrate realistic volatility clustering. Compare the curve with real returns and the shuffled control.

conditioning_study.hypothesis: Static starting-book gaps may reduce incompatible cumulative price paths without suppressing noise diversity.
conditioning_study.context: 19 log relative price gaps, standardised using complete training-window anchors only; supplied to all five networks.
conditioning_study.architecture_control: Both models have identical parameter counts, initial weights, minibatch and noise streams; zero mode replaces the 19 context values with zeros.
conditioning_study.evaluation: Same 1080 chronological validation windows, anchors, metrics and three noise seeds as before; final test unscored. Different information budget, so historical anchor-only scores are supplementary.
conditioning_study.decision: Pilot only. Consider independent paired seed repeats if matched context reduces invalidity by at least 5 percentage points while return/spread KL and ACF error increase no more than 5%, depth SSIM falls no more than 0.01, and noise diversity remains. Screen all criteria together, including fixed-final checkpoints; do not claim significance or select a lucky seed.
conditioning_study.diversity: Measure noise variation within each of three fixed contexts, separately for price and volume, against real validation feature variability. Between-context variability alone is insufficient.
conditioning_study.estimate_basis: Prior two-worker 5000/stage fits took about 64-69 minutes; new networks have 61361 versus 54521 parameters. Estimate includes allowance, not a guarantee.
